_note: Curated (hand-verified against sion.bin.json). Q (Decimating Smash) can be tapped (instant, min charge) or held up to ~1.5s (max charge); calc 'MinDamageTotal' (LowDamage + 0.3-0.9 bonus-aware total AD via mStatFormula-less mStat 2) models the guaranteed untapped tap-cast, since real hold duration is a player choice this project doesn't infer (P2) -- 'MaxDamageTotal' exists in the BIN (HighDamage + up to 2.7x AD) but is not modeled to avoid overstating a combo the player didn't actually charge. W (Soul Furnace) explosion 'TotalDamage' = EffectValue(index2, flat 15-165) + 0.4 AP -- confirmed FLAT+AP, not %HP (the DataValues 'DamagePercentHealthTooltip' entry is display-only tooltip data never referenced by the real TotalDamage calc, cross-checked against mEffectAmount index2 raw numbers). E (Roar of the Slayer) 'TotalDamage' = BaseDamage + 0.55 AP, Magic; also applies a real flat ArmorShred (25, 4s) confirmed in DataValues -- tagged ArmorShred at slot level (the shred itself isn't a separate damage hit, so no extra hit added). R (Unstoppable Onslaught) 'MinDamageTotal' = MinDamage(bonus-aware total AD via mStatFormula=2, mCoefficient 0.6) at min charge/instant impact, same tap-vs-hold reasoning as Q; tagged BurstCeiling as Sion's highest realistic single-hit contribution in a combo (900 base at rank3 + bonus AD, well above Q/E). P (Glory in Death / Zombie Sion) has NO mSpellCalculations in the BIN -- it grants near-death lifesteal + a permanent post-death stat conversion, not a combo-time damage hit -- correctly left with no hits entry (not auto:true; a genuine no-damage passive).
